ios.desc:
Lost paws need found hearts. StraySync is your go-to app for locating and tracking stray animals in your area. Whether it’s a curious cat or a wandering dog, you can make a difference—one pin at a time.

How It Works:

Spot & Pin: See a stray? Snap a photo and drop a pin on the map with its exact location.
Share the Story: Upload the stray’s picture to help others recognize it.
Find & Help: Tap a pin to see the animal’s photo and get directions to its spot.
Built with compassion in mind, StraySync empowers animal lovers to team up and support strays in need. Whether you’re reuniting pets with owners or alerting local rescuers, every pin brings us closer to a world where no stray goes unnoticed.

Key Features:

Easy-to-use map to mark and find stray animals
Photo uploads for quick identification
Directions to guide you to each pinned location
Community-driven: help strays, one tap at a time
Download StraySync today and start syncing up to save strays in your neighborhood!
